{{Top|fa}} {{Otheruses|Gilad}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:GiladPellaeon-CardTrader.png]] |name=Gilad Pellaeon |homeworld=[[Corellia]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]] {{C|[[Corellian]]}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 23: The Spies}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}} |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|White]]{{TOTE|The Path of Anger}} {{AD|Disney+}} |feathers= |eyes=Blue{{SWCT|set=Radiant - 2024|cardname=Captain Gilad Pellaeon}} |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]]''[[Thrawn: Treason]]'' **[[Imperial Navy's officer corps]] **[[96th Task Force]]"[[The Path of Anger]]" establishes that Gilad Pellaeon served in [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] forces during the latter's [[time]] as an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[admiral]], which [[Thrawn (novel)|''Thrawn'']] identifies as the [[96th Task Force]] of the [[Imperial Navy]]. **[[Third Fleet]] **[[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]] *[[Neo-Imperial forces]]{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 23: The Spies}} **[[Shadow Council (Imperial Remnants)|Shadow Council]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Pellaeon is completely loyal.''"
"''I agree. But his loyalty is to the Empire, not you.|Grand Admirals Balanhai Savit and Thrawn|audio=PellaeonLoyal.flac|}} '''Gilad Pellaeon''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] who served as a [[captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. During his service in the [[96th Task Force]] led by [[Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]], Pellaeon participated in select Imperial gatherings to search for promising individuals to bring into his admiral's service. One such recruit was [[Magistrate]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]] of [[Corvus]], whom the captain met when the former showcased her [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]] designs to a group of [[Imperial officer]]s. Pellaeon was later assigned to [[Grand Admiral]] [[Balanhai Savit]]'s [[Third Fleet]] and given the [[Commanding officer|command]] of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Harbinger (Third Fleet)|''Harbinger'']]. When Savit was exposed as a [[Treason|traitor]] who was [[Thief|stealing]] components from [[Project Stardust]], Pellaeon sided with [[Commodore]] [[Karyn Faro]] and helped her arrest his superior. After Savit was relieved of his duty, Pellaeon and the ''Harbinger'' were reassigned to assist Thrawn's [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]]. Together with Thrawn, by then a Grand Admiral, Pellaeon participated in the Imperial [[blockade]] of the planet [[Lothal]] until it was [[Liberation of Lothal|liberated]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[Spectres]] and [[Lothal resistance group|their allies]] in [[1 BBY]]. During the liberation, all Imperial [[starship]]s present were destroyed by flocks of the [[Realspace|spacefaring]] [[purrgil]], and Pellaeon's communication with the Grand Admiral was quickly cut off. Although the captain survived the battle, Thrawn disappeared into the unknown when the creatures pulled his [[flagship]], the ''[[Chimaera]]'', into [[hyperspace]]. Pellaeon continued to fight against the Rebel Alliance in the [[Galactic Civil War]] and went into hiding after the Empire's [[Battle of Jakku|defeat]]. While the Alliance reorganized itself as the [[New Republic]], the Empire fractured into various holdouts. Alongside other [[Imperial Remnants|Imperial Remnant]] [[warlord]]s, such as [[Moff]] [[Gideon]] and [[Commandant]] [[Brendol Hux]], Pellaeon formed the [[Shadow Council (Imperial Remnants)|Shadow Council]] to secretly coordinate their efforts to restore the Empire. Representing his own [[Gilad Pellaeon's delegation|delegation]] in the Council, the captain believed that Thrawn's return and leadership would allow the resurgence of the [[Imperial Military]], though he was faced with skepticism by Gideon. In a Council meeting held around [[9 ABY]], Pellaeon and Hux agreed to send reinforcements for [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|Gideon's forces]] to foil the [[Mandalorian]]s' plan to [[Liberation of Mandalore|retake]] their [[homeworld]] [[Mandalore]], albeit without success. ==Biography== ===Serving Admiral Thrawn=== {{Quote|My superior sends me to these meetings to search for people with a particular vision. However, I have a question for you. Why is it that you want to lend your substantial talents and vision to the Empire?|Captain Pellaeon, to Morgan Elsbeth|audio=PellaeonElsbeth-TotE.flac|{{TOTE|The Path of Anger}}}} [[File:PellaeonElsbethTalk-TPoA.png|thumb|left|340px|Pellaeon attended certain Imperial meetings seeking out promising individuals such as Morgan Elsbeth.]] Gilad Pellaeon was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] from the [[Core Worlds]] [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Gilad Pellaeon was an [[Imperial officer]] who held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[captain]] within the [[Imperial Navy]], serving in [[Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[96th Task Force]]. Under Thrawn's directives, Pellaeon attended select gatherings of Imperial personnel, scouting for promising individuals who shared a specific vision. Sometime between [[9 BBY]] and [[2 BBY]],The events of "[[The Path of Anger]]" take place during [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[time]] as an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[admiral]], which corresponds to between [[9 BBY]] and [[2 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. Pellaeon participated in one such assembly aboard an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] above the [[Ecumenopolis|city planet]] of [[Coruscant]]. There, he observed a presentation by [[Morgan Elsbeth]], the [[magistrate]] of the planet [[Corvus]], showcasing her designs for an advanced [[starfighter]] called the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter|TIE Defender]] in hopes of striking a deal with the Empire for its production. While Pellaeon was impressed by Elsbeth and her work, [[Moff]] [[Isdain]] abruptly terminated the magistrate's negotiation and expressed his intent to forcibly acquire the resources of Corvus and its neighboring [[star system]]s on behalf of the Empire. Once Isdain and other [[officer]]s exited the boardroom, Pellaeon approached the disheartened magistrate, praising her work and inquiring about the alteration to the [[engine]] manifold in her fighter design. After reassuring Elsbeth of his genuine interest, unlike Isdain's scheme to exploit her resources, Pellaeon questioned the magistrate about her decision to offer her services to the Empire. Elsbeth then responded with a canned answer about serving "the glory of the Empire," to which Pellaeon acknowledged by pondering for a moment and thanked her for her time before leaving the room. [[File:PellaeonElsbethRukh-TPoA.png|thumb|right|340px|Pellaeon witnessed Elsbeth besting Rukh in combat on the rampart of Calodan, the capital of Corvus.]] Pellaeon later conveyed his encounter with Elsbeth to Thrawn, who soon traveled to [[Calodan]], the [[capital]] [[city]] of Corvus,{{EncyclopediaCite|Ahsoka Tano and Other Users of the Force}} with the captain to meet the magistrate in person. There, they first assessed Elsbeth's combat prowess by sending the [[Noghri]] [[assassin]] [[Rukh]] to attack her on the city's rampart. As the assassin was bested by Elsbeth, Pellaeon approached the two, commending the magistrate's triumph and dismissing Rukh. After Pellaeon explained to the magistrate that the skirmish was a deliberate test, he expressed his eagerness to collaborate with her and left, leaving the scene for Thrawn, who welcomed Elsbeth to his service. ===Assignment to the Third Fleet=== {{Quote|This is Captain Gilad Pellaeon, commanding the ISD ''Harbinger''. I've reviewed the data sent by the ''Chimaera'', and have concluded that the evidence is sufficient to justify an official inquiry. Accordingly, I am placing the ''Harbinger'' under the authority of Commodore Faro and calling on Grand Admiral Savit to surrender his command. I also call on Captains Lochry and Rasdel to join me—|Captain Pellaeon turns against Grand Admiral Savit|audio=ThisIsPellaeon.flac|}} [[File:Thrawn-ToL.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Following the arrest of the traitorous Grand Admiral Savit, Pellaeon was assigned to Grand Admiral Thrawn's (pictured) Seventh Fleet.]] Some time later, Pellaeon was assigned to [[Grand Admiral]] [[Balanhai Savit]]'s [[Third Fleet]] as the [[commanding officer]] of the Imperial [[Star Destroyer]] [[Harbinger (Third Fleet)|''Harbinger'']], though the Grand Admiral was not satisfied with the degree of Pellaeon's personal loyalty to him. During the [[fleet]]'s [[Anti-piracy campaign in the Esaga sector|anti-piracy campaign]] in the [[Esaga sector]] in [[1 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Savit ordered Pellaeon and the latter's [[Gilad Pellaeon's first officer|first officer]] to meet him to discuss a [[pirate]]-hunting mission. However, unbeknownst to Pellaeon, the Grand Admiral himself had hired the pirates in order to [[Thief|steal]] components from [[Project Stardust]], which saw the construction of the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]]. Not long after, Thrawn— who had been promoted to Grand Admiral of the [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]] and was aiming to remove Savit from command by exposing his [[Treason|treachery]]—asked Savit to turn over the [[Prisoner|captive]] [[Assistant Director]] [[Brierly Ronan]] to him and sent coordinates for a rendezvous. Savit traveled to the prearranged [[star]] system with four Star Destroyers, including Pellaeon's ''Harbinger'', and met with Thrawn's [[flagship]], the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Chimaera]]'', commanded by [[Commodore]] [[Karyn Faro]]. Suspecting an ambush, Savit sent the ''Harbinger'' to sweep a nearby [[Unidentified mobile way station|space station]], which was actually used by Savit's pirates, as a precaution to keep Pellaeon away from a possible conflict. Savit also gave Pellaeon permission to send over boarding parties if he wished, which the captain benefited from by dispatching an advance survey team to the [[Space station|station]], even though the Grand Admiral would later ignore Pellaeon's report on the matter. Meanwhile, Faro transmitted evidence of Savit's complicity with the pirates to the Third Fleet personnel. Shortly after, Savit's three remaining Star Destroyers engaged in a [[Skirmish against the Third Fleet|skirmish]] against the ''Chimaera''. During the encounter, Pellaeon reviewed the evidence against Savit and concluded that an official inquiry against the Grand Admiral was justified. Pellaeon then called for Savit to surrender his command, as well as calling on fellow Captains [[Lochry]] and [[Rasdel]] to join him. He further placed the ''Harbinger'' under the command of Faro. Following Savit's arrest, [[Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] reassigned Pellaeon and the ''Harbinger'' to the Seventh Fleet, believing the captain might prove useful to Thrawn's ongoing [[Lothal campaign|struggle]] against the [[Lothalite]] [[Lothal resistance group|insurgents]]. On the Grand Admiral's order, Faro contacted the reassigned captain and arranged a rendezvous of the ''Harbinger'' with Thrawn's fleet at the planet [[Lothal]]. ===Imperial blockade of Lothal and continuing the fight=== {{Quote|Get Captain Pellaeon.''"
"''Sir, they came out of hyperspace! I've never seen…|Grand Admiral Thrawn and Pellaeon encounter the purrgil over Lothal|audio=Pellaeon_Blockade.flac|{{Rebels|Family Reunion – and Farewell}}}} [[File:Lothal_Blockade.png|thumb|right|285px|Captain Pellaeon participated in Thrawn's blockade of the planet Lothal.]] Later in 1 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], Pellaeon took part in the Empire's [[orbit]]al [[blockade]] around Lothal as part of Thrawn's fleet. However, the blockade failed to stop a band of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]], led by [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]] of the [[Spectres]], from launching an attack that [[Liberation of Lothal|liberated]] the planet from its Imperial occupation. While Thrawn was dealing with the rebels on the planet's surface, he learned that the entire blockade was destroyed by several objects not identifiable to the Imperials. The Grand Admiral subsequently contacted Pellaeon to inquire about the situation, and the captain reported that their attackers had come out of [[hyperspace]] before their communication was quickly severed. Moments later, Thrawn discovered that the Imperial [[Starship|vessels]] were destroyed by flocks of [[purrgil]]—massive, [[whale]]like [[Species|creatures]] that were naturally capable of traveling through hyperspace—as part of Bridger's attack.''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' Although Pellaeon survived the battle, Thrawn and Bridger went missing in action as both were aboard the ''Chimaera'' when the ship was carried into hyperspace by the purrgil, leaving Thrawn stranded in a [[far galaxy]].{{Ahsoka|Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord}} Having lost the liberated planet to the rebels, the Empire never again returned to Lothal. Following Thrawn's disappearance, Pellaeon continued to fight against the Rebel Alliance during the [[Galactic Civil War]], and was among the Grand Admiral's subordinates whose promotion was stalled as some Imperials wished for Thrawn's legacy to be a failure.''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' ===New Republic Era=== {{Quote|Captain Pellaeon, you always speak with much authority, and yet, I see, once again, that Grand Admiral Thrawn is missing from your delegation. Any word on when he will be able to participate in the Shadow Council?''"
"''With respect, our one hope for success relies upon the secrecy of his return.|Moff Gideon and Captain Pellaeon in a Shadow Council meeting|audio=Gideon-Pellaeon.flac|}} [[File:MandoShadowCouncil.png|thumb|left|340px|Pellaeon, along with other members of the fallen Galactic Empire, formed part of the Shadow Council.]] After the Empire lost the war against the Rebel Alliance, which restyled itself as the [[New Republic]]. With the apparent [[death]] of [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] at the [[Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY]], the Empire shattered into various remnant factions. Pellaeon went into hiding and along with other Imperial loyalists formed the secret [[Shadow Council (Imperial Remnants)|Shadow Council]], which consisted of [[Imperial Remnants|remnant Imperial]] [[warlord]]s wanted by the Republic, in hopes of restoring the Empire to its former glory. The captain represented his own [[Gilad Pellaeon's delegation|delegation]] in the Council, whose members each operated in a particular [[sector]] of [[the galaxy]]. Along with fellow council member [[Commandant]] [[Brendol Hux]], Pellaeon held a considerable amount of resources and equipment at his disposal. Around [[9 ABY]],{{MandoDate|23}} Pellaeon attended a meeting of the Shadow Council via [[hologram]], during which he warned an [[Unidentified Imperial warlord (commander)|Imperial warlord]] about the latter's [[Pillage of hyperspace routes|hit-and-run operations]] to plunder the [[Hyperspace route|hyperspace lanes]], believing they were gaining too much New Republic attention. While other council members voiced their opinions in favor of a demonstration of power for citizens of the [[galaxy]], Pellaeon advised the group to be cautious about revealing their true strength until the imminent return of Grand Admiral Thrawn, which, in his opinion, would bring forth the reemergence of the [[Imperial Military]], while proving sufficient [[time]] for the completion of [[Project Necromancer]] supervised by Hux. [[File:PellaeonWarlord2-TheSpies.png|thumb|right|300px|Unlike some of his colleagues, Pellaeon believed the Shadow Council should refrain from gaining the New Republic's attention.]] Moff [[Gideon]], another member of the Shadow Council, was skeptical about Pellaeon's claims and openly criticized the captain for speaking with much confidence despite the lack of evidence of Thrawn's return. Although Pellaeon tried to assure him by stating that it was kept secret, Gideon suggested to the Council that perhaps a new leader should be sought, a proposition that saw support by some of the warlords, much to the displeasure of Pellaeon. During the remainder of the meeting, Hux and Pellaeon also reviewed the Moff's request for reinforcements for [[Gideon's Imperial remnant|his forces]], including three [[Praetorian Guard]]s, [[TIE/IN interceptor|TIE interceptors]], and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE bombers]]. Although Pellaeon mocked Gideon's request for [[Bodyguard|guards]] at first, he was concerned to hear the Moff was up against [[Mandalorian]]s, an ancient society of legendary [[Mandalorian warrior|warriors]] preparing to [[Liberation of Mandalore|reclaim]] their [[homeworld]] of [[Mandalore]]. Fearing that a Mandalorian resurgence would hinder the Council's designs, Pellaeon, alongside Hux, approved Gideon's request. With his promise of victory against the Mandalorians, the Moff uttered the [[List of phrases and slang|phrase]] "[[Long live the Empire]]," which was echoed by the other council members in unison. Despite the Shadow Council's support, Gideon ultimately failed to stop the Mandalorians from retaking their homeworld, which cost him his life.{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 24: The Return}} Not long after, thanks to Elsbeth's efforts, Thrawn returned from his [[Exile (punishment)|exile]] in the far galaxy as Pellaeon hoped. ===Legacy=== In [[35 ABY]],{{RiseAndFallDate}} the [[historian]] [[Beaumont Kin]] mentioned Pellaeon in the fifteenth chapter of his [[book]], ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'', in a section discussing the Imperial fleet and its combat engagements. In the work, Kin discussed Pellaeon's lack of immediate promotion following the Battle of Lothal compared to others under Thrawn's command. The historian presumed that some individuals wished for Thrawn's legacy to be one of failure, noting that Pellaeon was passed over for advancement due to the decisions of some Imperials. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Captain Pellaeon's not a blind follower, and Savit knows it.|Commodore Karyn Faro|audio=PellaeonFollower.flac|}} [[File:MandoPellaeon.png|thumb|left|260px|Captain Pellaeon was loyal to the Empire even after the regime fell.]] Gilad Pellaeon possessed [[Color|blue]] [[eye]]s, light skin, and white [[hair]] with a mustache. By 2 BBY, the captain had an elderly appearance. While serving in Thrawn's 96th [[Task force|Task Force]], Pellaeon was intrigued by Elsbeth following her [[TIE series|TIE]] Defender presentation, recognizing her as a potential asset to the Empire. When the magistrate demonstrated her combat proficiency against Rukh, he was impressed and indicated his keen interest in working with her while tipping his [[Imperial kepi|kepi]]. As an Imperial officer, Pellaeon's loyalty lay with the Empire itself instead of blindly following any individual commander. After receiving evidence suggesting his commanding officer, Grand Admiral Savit, had committed treason, Pellaeon turned against Savit and demanded his surrender. During the Liberation of Lothal, Captain Pellaeon was astonished upon witnessing the purrgil swarm coming out of hyperspace and attacking the blockade of Imperial starships over the planet. After the Empire's fall, Pellaeon's loyalty to the regime endured as he continued to work for the Imperial remnants. While he found the New Republic to be vulnerable, Pellaeon believed the remaining Imperial forces must not waste their strength and should operate discreetly without revealing the coordination between the remnant factions. The captain coveted Thrawn's leadership for the remains of the Empire and saw the Grand Admiral's return as their only hope for success. In return, Thrawn deeply trusted Pellaeon's judgement.{{ShipsandVehiclesCite|99|Pilots and Crew Members}} ==Skills and abilities== {{Quote|I have no doubt Captain Pellaeon's presence will be unnecessary to your final victory against this current rebel activity, but he may prove useful to you.|Grand Moff Tarkin, to Thrawn|audio=TarkinReassignsPellaeon.flac|}} [[File:PellaeonInspectsDefenderDesign-TPoA.png|thumb|right|330px|Pellaeon inspects Morgan Elsbeth's designs for the TIE Defender.]] Gilad Pellaeon was a capable military officer whose skills were noticed by high-ranking Imperials such as Grand Admiral Savit and Grand Moff Tarkin. He possessed a degree of knowledge about the inner workings of a starfighter as he was able to appreciate the sophistication of Elsbeth's schematics for the TIE Defender. The captain was also fluent in the [[Galactic Basic Standard]] [[language]]. ==Equipment== Pellaeon wore a gray [[Imperial officer's uniform]] along with an Imperial [[Hat|kepi]], a pair of black [[glove]]s, and a black [[belt]]. Both his kepi and belt buckle featured an [[officer's disk]] on the front. The captain's [[Clothing|tunic]] was adorned by [[code cylinder]]s in small pockets near the shoulders and a [[rank insignia plaque]] on the top left torso, which consisted of three squares followed by a blue square when the single line plaques were the norm in the Empire.''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' By the time of the [[New Republic Era]], his rank plaque had three red squares over three blue squares, and his tunic featured the [[Chimaera (symbol)|emblem]] of the Seventh Fleet on the left shoulder. ==Behind the scenes== ===Reintroduction into ''Star Wars'' canon=== {{Quote|I just wanted to mention the name so it gets in there, so it's something people can use. And sometimes that's what I can do for things that come out of Legends. I could create just another Captain with some name there or I could put someone like Pellaeon in play. And then maybe he gets picked up in comics or novels, I don't know. But I think that would be kind of fun to do, and it's a way to get that idea rolling.|Dave Filoni, on the inclusion of Pellaeon in ''Star Wars Rebels''|{{WebCite|url=https://gizmodo.com/that-fan-favorite-eu-character-name-dropped-on-star-war-1823592926|text=That Fan Favorite EU Character Name Dropped on ''Star Wars Rebels'' Is Alive and Well|author=Germain Lussier|date=2018-03-07|work=[[Wikipedia:io9|io9]]|archivedate=20210924114011}}}} [[File:XanderBerkeley.jpg|thumb|left|270px|Actor Xander Berkeley portrays Gilad Pellaeon in ''The Mandalorian'' and ''Tales of the Empire''.]] Gilad Pellaeon was reintroduced into ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' animated series finale, "[[Family Reunion – and Farewell]]," which was written by executive producer [[Dave Filoni]] and his team and first aired on [[March 5]], [[2018]].{{SW|url=news/the-final-episodes-of-star-wars-rebels-begin-february-19-on-disney-xd|text=The Final Episodes of ''Star Wars Rebels'' Begin February 19 on Disney XD|date=2018-01-19}} The character was voiced by [[Jim Cummings]], who was also the voice of [[Hondo Ohnaka]] in the series. Although author [[Timothy Zahn]], the character's original creator in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], was not informed of Pellaeon's inclusion in ''Star Wars Rebels'' beforehand,{{YouTube|channel=@StarWarsExplained|name=Star Wars Explained|video=GYUk_LmQKz4|text=Timothy Zahn Full Interview – Dragon Con 2018|date=2018-09-08|quote=I was not expecting that as well.}} {{C|In response to: "And of course, Pellaeon got a shoutout…"}} he later used the character in his [[2019]] novel ''[[Thrawn: Treason]]'', written as the third installment of ''[[Star Wars: The Imperial Trilogy]]'', which reintroduced the character's first name of "Gilad" into canon. Pellaeon was first pictured, albeit in hologram form, via the character's live-action debut in "[[Chapter 23: The Spies]]," the seventh episode of the [[Disney+]] original series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''{{'s}} [[The Mandalorian Season Three|third season]], which was written by Filoni and [[Jon Favreau]] and premiered on [[April 12]], [[2023]].{{InsiderCite|222|Star Wars: The Mandalorian Season Three Companion|''Star Wars: The Mandalorian'' Season Three Companion}} In the episode, Pellaeon was played by actor [[Xander Berkeley]], whose portrayal of the character was praised by Zahn.{{YouTube|video=GgHN8Mk_cRs|text=INTERVIEW WITH TIMOTHY ZAHN|channel=@LaTribunedeCoruscant|name=La Tribune de Coruscant|date=2023-05-04|quote=I liked the actor and his portrayal.}} {{C|In response to: "[…] what was your reaction when you saw Pellaeon in ''The Mandalorian''?"}} Berkeley had to shave his beard but keep his mustache to bring Pellaeon to life{{Twitter|xanderberkeley|status/1646186011758673928|[[Xander Berkeley]]|date=2023-04-12|quote=Hmmm… I wonder what pop culture genre classic I'll pop up in today? Hint: I had to shave the beard but keep the tashe. (My new oeuvre appears to be basing my look on a comic book) I mean Graphic Novel! 😅|archivedate=20230413052435|nolive=1}} based on the character's depiction in ''Star Wars'' Legends media.''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' Berkeley reprised his role as the voice of Pellaeon in "[[The Path of Anger]]," the second episode of the animated anthology ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Empire]]'' released on [[May 4]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=series/tales-of-the-empire|text=''Star Wars: Tales of the Empire''|quote=Release Date: May 4, 2024}} In celebration of May 4, [[2025]], Berkeley posted pictures of himself in Pellaeon's costume and a Legends Pallaeon ''[[Star Wars: The Vintage Collection|Vintage Collection]]'' figure to his Instagram page.{{Instagram|username=xanderoriginal|url=p/DJP3WgxSukt|name=[[Xander Berkeley]]|date=2025-05-04|quote=May the 4th Be with You ! (But Long Live the Empire!!). Doll by @hasbro choreography by @jwhitbrook|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/ydqSV}} ===Further canon stories and continuity=== {{Quote|We set up Captain Pellaeon in ''The Mandalorian'', and that's a character that goes with Thrawn, so I'd love to see the two of them together.|Dave Filoni, on possible future stories with Pellaeon|{{WebCite|url=https://www.empireonline.com/tv/news/dave-filoni-teases-thrawns-future-star-wars-rebels-hera-exclusive|text=Dave Filoni Teases Thrawn's Future In Star Wars: 'His Foil Throughout Rebels Was Hera' – Exclusive|author=Ben Travis|date=2023-12-19|work=[[Wikipedia:Empire (magazine)|''Empire'']]|quote=As for what his plan actually entails, Dave Filoni teased a few hints of what comes after [Thrawn's] return from exile. […] 'We set up Captain Pellaeon in ''The Mandalorian'', and that's a character that goes with Thrawn, so I'd love to see the two of them together,' Filoni teases.|archivedate=20240513011545}}}} [[File:DaveFiloni-SWCE2023.jpg|thumb|right|275px|Following Pellaeon's introduction in ''Star Wars Rebels'' and ''The Mandalorian'', Dave Filoni expressed his interest in reuniting the character with Thrawn in future New Republic–era stories.]] Filoni described bringing back Legends characters like Pellaeon into canon as being one of his favorite parts of the job. He said that bringing in Pellaeon in ''Star Wars Rebels'' serves as both an [[Easter egg (virtual)|Easter egg]] for fans of the old Expanded Universe{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars Rebels: Complete Season Four|episode=Family Reunion – and Farewell}} and an opportunity for other authors to explore new stories for the character in canon, which creating a new character with a new name would not necessarily allow for. Before the character's survival was confirmed in ''The Mandalorian'', Filoni had indicated that, in his opinion, Pellaeon somehow escaped and survived the events of the ''Star Wars Rebels'' finale—believing the character should not be "whimsically" killed off by a purrgil—and expressed hope that other authors would continue Pellaeon's story. He later hinted at the possibility of the character reuniting with Thrawn in the future New Republic–era stories set after the events of the [[Ahsoka Season 1|first season]] of ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'', a 2023 live-action series created by Filoni. A trivia quiz published in [[Titan Magazines]]' [[Star Wars Insider 222|''Star Wars Insider'' 222]] as part of the [[Star Wars Insider|magazine's]] recurring "[[Jedi Master's Quiz]]" department{{InsiderCite|222|Jedi Master's Quiz}} on [[October 31]], 2023{{TitanComics|url=m/142-star-wars-insider-222|text=Star Wars Insider #222}} describes Pellaeon as an admiral in a wrong answer for one of the questions. According to the Imperial rank chart in the 2023 reference book ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'', which was within a section written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]],{{WookYouTube|-nqSqVOvfM4|Wookieepedia Interviews - Emily Shkoukani & Jason Fry}} Pellaeon's rank insignia plaque seen in "The Path of Anger" denotes the rank of [[Imperial Army|army]] captain. However, since the 96th Task Force was a [[Navy|naval]] unit and the character is portrayed as a captain in the Imperial Navy in his other appearances, this article assumes Pellaeon was a naval captain at that time as well. ===Origins in ''Star Wars'' Legends=== {{Quote|Pellaeon, by the way, was named after Pelleas, an idealistic young knight in the King Arthur mythos.|Timothy Zahn|audio=Pelleas.flac|''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''}} [[File:AdmiralAlienAndCaptainMustache.jpg|thumb|left|225px|Captain Pellaeon was Grand Admiral Thrawn's
